posthogQa.sql: SELECT event, properties.traffic_medium AS medium, properties.traffic_campaign AS campaign, properties.pathname AS pathname, properties.ui_context AS context, count() AS events FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-03 05:10:19','UTC') AND distinct_id IN (SELECT distinct_id FROM events WHERE properties.traffic_campaign='admin_cleanup_20261002' AND properties.traffic_medium='qa' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-03 05:10:19','UTC')) GROUP BY event,medium,campaign,pathname,context ORDER BY event LIMIT 100
